Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Competitive, depending on experience

jobs.title: Security Program Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Security Program Manager based in India.

We are seeking an experienced cybersecurity professional to lead strategic security programs and initiatives that protect critical information assets and strengthen organizational resilience. In this role, you will oversee the planning, execution, and continuous improvement of security projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. You will collaborate with IT, engineering, and business teams to identify risks, implement effective controls, and integrate security into operational processes and the software development lifecycle. Your responsibilities will span vulnerability management, incident response, security audits, compliance, and employee awareness. Through data-driven reporting and stakeholder engagement, you will communicate program progress, highlight emerging risks, and drive informed decision-making. This remote opportunity offers the chance to influence enterprise security strategy while working with diverse teams in a dynamic, technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities

Develop and implement comprehensive security programs, strategies, and roadmaps aligned with organizational objectives, recognized security frameworks, and industry best practices.
Manage the complete lifecycle of security projects, including planning, resource coordination, execution, monitoring, risk management, and reporting, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines and budgets.
Lead cross-functional teams in identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and mitigating security risks across systems, applications, networks, and infrastructure.
Establish, maintain, and improve security policies, standards, procedures, and controls in alignment with frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, and applicable regulatory requirements, including GDPR.
Oversee vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security audit activities, coordinating remediation efforts and tracking progress through to resolution.
Collaborate with IT, engineering, and business stakeholders to embed security requirements into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and broader operational processes.
Develop and deliver security awareness and education programs that promote secure practices and strengthen employee understanding of cybersecurity responsibilities.
Maintain and improve security incident response plans, procedures, and exercises to support effective detection, response, recovery, and incident resolution.
Evaluate emerging security technologies and solutions, recommending improvements that enhance organizational security capabilities and operational effectiveness.
Prepare and present security metrics, program updates, risk assessments, and performance reports to senior management and relevant stakeholders.
Monitor emerging cyber threats, security technologies, regulatory changes, and industry developments to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Coordinate program priorities and manage dependencies across multiple initiatives while maintaining clear communication, accountability, and alignment with business goals.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field; a master’s degree is preferred.
At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in information security, including a minimum of 3 years in security program management.
Proven experience managing complex cybersecurity programs and projects using established project management methodologies, such as Agile or Waterfall.
Strong understanding of information security principles, governance frameworks, controls, and industry best practices, including NIST, ISO 27001, and COBIT.
Broad technical knowledge across application security, network security, cloud security, data protection, and identity and access management.
Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, and SOX.
Experience overseeing security risk assessments, vulnerability remediation, penetration testing, security audits, and incident response initiatives.
Relevant professional certifications, such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Privacy Professional/United States (CIPP/US), or equivalent credentials, are highly desirable.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and sound judgment when assessing risks and prioritizing security initiatives.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects and competing priorities, and adapt to changing requirements in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational and reporting skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, program performance, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.

Benefits

Employment type: Full-time position.
Location: Remote, India.
Flexible working arrangements: Flexible work options designed to support work-life balance, subject to role and location requirements.
Health and well-being: Access to benefits, support, and services intended to promote overall employee health and well-being.
Professional development: Opportunities to expand cybersecurity expertise and contribute to enterprise-wide security initiatives.
Meaningful impact: Opportunity to influence security strategy, improve organizational resilience, and strengthen risk management practices.
Collaborative environment: Work alongside global teams and professionals across technology, engineering, and business functions.
Autonomy and ownership: Scope to lead programs, drive improvements, and contribute to strategic decisions.
Inclusive culture: A workplace that values diversity, mutual respect, equal opportunity, and merit-based development.
Salary and additional benefits: Specific compensation figures, healthcare plan details, paid leave entitlements, and other benefits were not specified in the available job description.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

DailyPay is the leader in On-Demand Pay, helping employers modernize how people get their pay. DailyPay serves more than 1,900 employers and over 6 million employees, including many of the world's most recognized brands. By providing real-time access to earned pay and financial wellness tools, DailyPay helps employees manage their finances and helps employers attract and retain talent. DailyPay is helping define the future of pay, where money moves at the speed of work. Learn more at DailyPay's Press Center.

The Role

DailyPay is seeking a forward-thinking, organized, and enthusiastic Implementation Manager to join our rapidly growing company in NYC. This individual will be a pivotal member of our Implementation team, leading the deployment of our SaaS solution for our Small to Enterprise sized accounts. This person will lead the technical integration between third party vendors and DailyPay. The Implementation Manager will be responsible for managing the entire implementation lifecycle from pre-sales to go-live. Success in this role will rely on a combination of strong discovery skills, technical proficiency, confidence, working with clients and C Suite stakeholders, and the ability to manage the details while seeing the bigger picture. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the qualifications.

How You Will Make An Impact

Lead the technical aspects of the DailyPay integration for Small to Enterprise sized customers
Perform comprehensive discovery and build robust documentation of the implementation requirements
Perform technical research to provide unique solutions for complex customer integrations
Become a specialist in our product, configuration, and internal processes
Identify, manage, and mitigate project risks
Work hand in hand with the sales team to assist with pre-sales and scoping discussions
Suggest new product features and functionality based on implementation experience and feedback from DailyPay customers
Work closely with the operations and support teams to discuss implementation details and nuances during the post-launch handoff

What You Bring To The Team

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or equivalent work experience
3-5+ years of experience in Implementation of SaaS solutions
Experience working with demanding, high-stakes accounts, managing operational and C-level stakeholders, and supporting day-to-day needs to manage these relationships
Detail-oriented with the ability to set priorities and be flexible in a changing environment
Excellent written communication and presentation skills
Experience leading data validation, unit testing, and UAT
Experience with sFTP automation and API builds (reviewing logs, troubleshooting, etc.)
Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Suite
Experience in early stage products, markets, and companies preferred
Occasional need to work outside of normal business hours as required to support customers may be required

Nice To Haves

Experience with HCM, Payroll and Time Management Systems
Experience with Dell Boomi or similar products

What We Offer

Exceptional health, vision, and dental care
Opportunity for equity ownership
Life and AD&D, short- and long-term disability
Employee Assistance Program
Employee Resource Groups
Fun company outings and events
Unlimited PTO
401K with company match

High-performing cultures aren't built in silos, they thrive on partnership. At DailyPay, we Commit Together
to an inclusive, professional environment where multifaceted perspectives are our greatest competitive advantage. We recognize that our team members don’t live “single-issue lives,” and we lean into the wide-ranging backgrounds and life stages that sharpen our collective decision-making.

In our high-trust environment, we empower you to Challenge Norms
. We’ve created a space where it is safe to ask difficult questions, disrupt the status quo, and share bold perspectives without fear of professional fallout. We believe that by checking our own assumptions and staying curious about the experiences of others, we arrive at better, more innovative results.

We provide the space for you to do your best work through peer advocacy and transparent career development. If you are looking for a culture that values intellectual honesty, celebrates the unique lived experiences of its people, and thrives on collective success, you’ll find it here.

If you require reasonable accommodation for any aspect of the recruitment process, please send a request to peopleops@dailypay.com. All requests for accommodation will be addressed as confidentially as practicable.

DailyPay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion or creed, alienage or citizenship status, political affiliation, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth (or related medical conditions), sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, genetic disorder, genetic predisposition, carrier status, military status, familial status, or domestic violence victim status and any other basis protected under federal, state, or local laws.

Compensation Range: $86K - $131K

Do you want to increase your skills and contribute to the development of a dynamic and fast-growing company? Do you want to support our teams on a daily basis? Does taking on challenges in France or internationally appeal to you?

Leader in the field of risk management, Airbus Protect is a 100% subsidiary of the Airbus Group. Do you want to contribute to the growth of our company?

Come join our talents and boost your career within Airbus Protect!

Join our Special Projects Department and take the lead on transformative initiatives that shape the future of our company!

As an Experienced Project Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of highly varied and complex projects. Your portfolio could include anything from the design and construction of a new corporate building, to the study and deployment of a new ERP system, or even the establishment of a new international subsidiary.

This is a key role for a strategic thinker with a talent for organization, collaboration and a passion for solving complex challenges. You will report to the Head of Special Projects.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and Drive Projects : You will guide assigned projects, overseeing all phases from initiation and planning to execution, monitoring, control, and closure.
Define Scope and Objectives : Work closely with stakeholders to clearly define project scopes, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria.
Oversee Budgets and Timelines: Diligently monitor and manage project budgets and schedules to ensure delivery is on time and within financial scope.
Manage Risks: Proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure smooth project progression.
Foster Clear Communication : Maintain clear, concise, and regular communication with all internal clients and key stakeholders, providing timely updates on project status, challenges, and successes.
Unite and Motivate Teams: Foster a collaborative and productive environment, effectively federating internal teams and external partners to achieve project goals.
Guide Through Challenges: Confidently address challenges, provide clear direction to keep projects on track, and facilitate effective conflict resolution.
Internal Client Satisfaction: Ensure the successful delivery of projects that meet or exceed the expectations of our internal clients.

Required Skills and Qualifications :

Proven Project Management Expertise: Extensive experience (typically 7+ years) in managing complex, multi-faceted projects, ideally with a background in diverse sectors or project types.
Exceptional Organizational Skills: Demonstrated ability to plan, organize, and execute complex undertakings with meticulous attention to details.
Strong Leadership & Federation Abilities: Proven track record of successfully leading, motivating, and uniting diverse teams and stakeholders towards a common goal.
Excellent Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Superior verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex information clearly and persuasively to all levels of an organization.
Confident Decision-Making : The ability to make sound, well-reasoned decisions, even under pressure, to guide the project forward and navigate obstacles.
Problem-Solving Acumen: Highly analytical with a strong ability to identify problems, analyze root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Budget & Time Management: Expert proficiency in managing project budgets and timelines, with a focus on efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
Client-Centric Approach: A strong commitment to understanding and meeting the needs of internal clients, ensuring their satisfaction.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities and project requirements.

Why Join Our Team?

This is an unparalleled opportunity to make a significant impact within our organization by leading strategic initiatives that directly contribute to our growth and success. You will work on the cutting edge of various business transformations and be a key player in shaping our future.

Are you ready to take on this exciting challenge and bring your proven project management prowess to our Special Projects Department? We look forward to hearing from you!

This position as Project Manager can be based in the Paris or Toulouse area

Are you THE one ?

You are graduate from a business school or engineering school or equivalent (Master degree or equivalent).
You have at least 5 years of experience in Project Management
you have solid knowledge of project management in different sectors
you master the operation of a company preferably in the field of service and consulting
you know how to take a step back and are curious to discover new areas and approaches
You are proactive and demonstrate autonomy
Knowledge of Airbus programs, processes and products would be a plus.
Those around you describe you as open-minded and dynamic.

Team spirit and interpersonal skills are assets that characterize you.
You can evolve in a multicultural and international environment
Are you full of suggestions? We are committed to supporting you in their achievements
English advanced needed.

Supportive and accessible local management

jobs.description:
Program Manager - First Mile / Middle Mile

About Blitz

Blitz enables Same-Day Delivery for eCommerce brands to provide the best on-time delivery experiences to their customers. Blitz aims to simplify scalability & unlock the growth of new-age eCommerce brands by making Same-Day delivery more convenient, reliable & affordable. Same-Day Delivery helps brands with converting their browsers into buyers, serving as a competitive advantage and reducing working capital challenges. Blitz currently engages with enterprise brands with category focus into Fashion, Beauty & Personal Care and Healthcare; helping them with 30% - 40% increase in their website conversions & increasing retention by 2x by providing best in class experience.

About The Role

We are looking for a Program Manager to drive initiatives across our first-mile and mid-mile network, covering the movement of goods from vendors to mother hubs and warehouses, and onward to dark stores. You will own programs that improve speed, cost, reliability, and scalability of inbound and line-haul operations, so that stores stay replenished on time in a high-velocity business.

Key Responsibilities

Program Ownership

Plan and run first-mile and mid-mile programs end to end, from scoping and milestones to delivery and post-launch review.
Maintain roadmaps, risk logs, and dependency trackers across Procurement, Warehousing, Transport, Finance, Tech, and Store Operations.
Run weekly and monthly business reviews and give leadership clear updates on progress, risks, and blockers.

First Mile Programs

Drive vendor pickup and inbound scheduling programs, including appointment booking, slot management, and dock-to-stock TAT improvement.
Improve farm-to-hub and vendor-to-warehouse flows for fresh and perishable categories, with a focus on quality, wastage, and cold chain.
Work with procurement on vendor delivery compliance, ASN accuracy, and inbound OTIF.

Mid Mile Programs

Optimize line-haul and hub-to-dark-store movement through route planning, trip consolidation, and fleet utilization.
Run transporter onboarding, rate contracts, and performance management programs (vehicle fill, TAT, damage, delivery adherence).
Improve replenishment cycle times and cut-off adherence so stores receive stock before peak demand windows.

Cost & Network Optimization

Reduce cost per kg / cost per case / cost per trip through route optimization, load planning, and vendor mix changes.
Support network design decisions such as hub placement, cross-docking, and milk-run models.
Build business cases and size savings for new initiatives.

Process, Tech & Automation

Define requirements and work with product and tech teams on TMS, route optimization, vehicle tracking (GPS/telematics), and inbound/outbound visibility tools.
Standardize SOPs for loading, unloading, seal and handover, GRN, and shortage/damage claims.
Reduce manual effort and turnaround time through process redesign and automation.

Analytics & Reporting

Build dashboards and track KPIs: inbound TAT, trip utilization, cost per trip, on-time dispatch and delivery, shortage and damage rates.
Use data to find bottlenecks, run root-cause analyses, and drive corrective actions.

Governance & Compliance

Ensure adherence to transport, safety, and statutory requirements (E-way bill, vehicle documentation, driver compliance, FSSAI for food movement).
Manage transporter SLAs, penalties, claims, and dispute resolution.

Qualifications

4–8 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, transport operations, or program management, ideally in e-commerce, quick commerce, retail, FMCG, or 3PL.
Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent from a reputed institute preferred.
Proven record of delivering cross-functional programs with measurable cost, speed, or reliability impact.

Remote Opportunity

Candidates must have permanent authorization to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. * *

Position Summary

The POS Solutions Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, implementation, integration, and delivery of Point of Sale (POS) solutions for retail customer-facing business environments. This role coordinates cross-functional teams, technology vendors, business stakeholders, and technical resources to deliver scalable, reliable, secure, and user-friendly POS solutions that support business objectives.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management skills with an understanding of POS technologies, payment processing, retail operations, system integrations, and software implementation methodologies. This individual will manage projects from initial requirements gathering through deployment, stabilization, and ongoing enhancements while ensuring delivery within established scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.

Project Management and Delivery

Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, resource plans, budgets, risk assessments, and status reports.
Manage project scope, dependencies, change requests, issues, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Coordinate multiple concurrent projects and ensure alignment with business priorities and delivery commitments.
Establish project governance, communication plans, status reporting, and escalation procedures.
Facilitate project meetings, stakeholder reviews, executive updates, and project closeout activities.

POS Solutions and Technology

Partner with technical teams to define solution requirements, evaluate design options, and address technical dependencies.
Support implementations involving cloud-based POS platforms, traditional on-premises systems, mobile POS, and omnichannel retail solutions.
Ensure solutions align with business requirements, performance expectations, security standards, and operational needs.

Manage deployment planning, cutover activities, rollback planning, and go-live readiness assessments.
Coordinate training, documentation, support handoffs, and operational readiness activities.
Oversee post-launch stabilization and ensure outstanding issues are appropriately tracked and resolved.
Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, delivery efficiency, system reliability, and user experience.

Risk, Compliance, and Quality

Monitor project quality and proactively identify issues that could affect delivery, customer experience, or business operations.

Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional projects involving business and technical stakeholders.
Experience with POS platforms, retail technology, payment processing, or comparable enterprise systems.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches.
Experience managing project schedules, budgets, risks, dependencies, scope, and resource capacity.
Excellent written and verbal communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, or equivalent platforms .

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management credential.
Experience implementing POS solutions across multiple stores, locations, business units, or regions.
Familiarity with payment processors, payment terminals, transaction authorization, settlement, refunds, and reconciliation.
Experience with POS platforms such as Oracle Retail Xstore , NCR Voyix , Toast, Square, Shopify POS, or comparable solutions.
Knowledge of integrations involving e-commerce platforms, ERP systems, inventory management, loyalty programs, and omnichannel commerce.
Familiarity with PCI DSS and other applicable payment security requirements.

Project planning, execution, and delivery leadership

Requirements analysis and scope control

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Nuclear Science & Technology (NS&T) directorate at Idaho National Laboratory is hiring a Program Manager to serve within our Business Operations group. This is a shared resource role supporting multiple groups across NS&T, so you'll bring fluency across the full spectrum of both program and project management disciplines. You'll be the point of accountability for integrated programs by aligning strategy, stakeholders, budgets, and schedules, while flexing to meet the distinct needs of the teams you support.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Define and communicate program vision, objectives, and success criteria that align with INL's mission, and establish the governance structures, decision frameworks, and escalation protocols that keep programs on track.
Manage interdependencies across multiple projects — coordinating resource allocation, milestone sequencing, and integration points, and making trade-off decisions that balance competing needs across the groups you serve.
Serve as the primary interface between NS&T and executive-level external stakeholders (e.g., DOE program offices, DOD sponsors, industry partners), leading business reviews, planning sessions, and contract negotiations.
Develop and manage multi-year program budgets spanning multiple funding sources, work breakdown structures, and cost pools, directing financial planning cycles and ensuring compliance with federal cost accounting standards.
Identify, assess, and manage strategic and institutional risks across projects, developing mitigation strategies for technical, schedule, funding, and stakeholder risks and escalating critical issues with recommended courses of action.
Provide leadership and direction to Project Managers and functional leads across the groups you support, fostering collaboration, resolving conflicts, and mentoring emerging program and project management talent.
Roll up your sleeves at the project level when needed — directly managing scope, budget, schedule, and technical milestones for individual projects, so you deliver value whether you're running a program or executing a project.

Why This Role Matters

Business Operations is the connective tissue that lets NS&T deliver on the nation's most consequential nuclear energy work. As a shared Program Manager, you'll multiply the impact of every group you touch — keeping first-of-a-kind programs aligned, funded, and on schedule, and ensuring INL continues to run its programs to the highest quality standards as the nation's leading nuclear energy laboratory.

Essential Job Functions And Responsibilities

Oversee multiple ongoing, rapidly expanding projects, some of which are managed by subordinate Project Managers.
Track project deliverables using appropriate tools. Ensure proper planning and scheduling for operational-related activities to support timely and successful completion of program/project work. Implement and manage project changes and interventions to achieve successful project outputs.
Proactively manage and execute sets of projects into programs on schedule and within assigned budgets. Act as appropriate to correct deviations from schedule and budget. Provide recommendations to project management to allow timely resolution of problems and issues. Use appropriate conflict resolution skills to manage competing stakeholder interests.
Direct or support engineering projects related to upgrading facilities, constructing new facilities to include planning, budgeting, procuring, and managing projects.
Aid in developing research, engineering, and operations teams to help partners meet their goals.
Interface with partners (DOE, DOW, and others) and coordinate among INL operations, research, and business organizations to support programs in the area of specialty.
Prepare or direct the preparation of progress and special reports to customer and management.
Ensure that laboratory requirements and standards for the management of projects are met and are consistently applied in the acceptance and integration of work. Integrate managed scope with ongoing and evolving mission needs.
Ensure that all customer contact, including major correspondence and work relationships between management and the customer, is maintained throughout the duration of the program. Conduct periodic project and customer meetings to review progress and discuss issues. Ensure problems involving coordination, schedule, and the setting of priorities are resolved by the project teams. Obtain the customer's acceptance of the work and document all turnover activities. Responsible for the preparation and submission of the final project reports and prompt close-out of the projects supporting the program.
Identify new opportunities and support growth in a dynamic and necessarily agile security R&D business environment. Match INL unique capabilities with capability gaps and needs of clients. Advise on emerging capabilities.
Analyze data to understand organizational disparities and implement solutions to address the identified disparity. Combine data analysis with experience/knowledge to deliver reliable and executable solutions.
Develop teams as appropriate to successfully complete projects.
Coach other managers, support succession planning, and actively develop future leaders at INL

Required

Level 3: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field from an accredited institution and 5 years of relevant experience; or an Advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field from an accredited institution and 2 years of relevant experience.
Level 4: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field from an accredited institution and 9 years of relevant experience; or a Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field from an accredited institution and 6 years of relevant experience; or a PhD in Business, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field from an accredited institution and 4 years of relevant experience.
Must have strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills.
Must demonstrate collaboration consistently and effectively.
Proven ability to manage program budgets, schedules, and performance metrics.
Experience functioning as a project lead, project manager, or lead role determined with level.
Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Must be a U.S. citizen and be required to obtain and maintain a “Q” DOE clearance.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

Advanced degree from an accredited institution.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification with demonstrated program-level experience, and/or Program Management Professional (PgMP®) certification or equivalent (or ability to obtain within a specified timeframe).
Fluency across the full range of program and project management disciplines, with the versatility to support multiple groups and shift between distinct mission priorities.
Proficiency in program management tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and familiarity with performance tracking methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, mentor emerging leaders, and interface effectively with government and external partners (e.g., DOE, DOD).

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, and work in an office and field/laboratory environment. The job requires hand/finger dexterity to keyboard or type, handle materials, manipulate tools, and reach with hands and arms. The job requires operation of job-related equipment and driving a vehicle. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds without assistance. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with the public is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

team. Our team works a 9x80

Job Summary

Manages a shift and/or segment of guarding operations at multiple sites at the direction of line management. Supervises Field Supervisors and other security personnel. Performs inspections and ensures that post orders are being followed. Coaches and trains personnel. Carries out administrative procedures in support of Branch operations.

Distinguishing Characteristics: Primary job function is the management of a segment of an office’s guarding operations. This job description applies only to salaried positions performing essential functions of the nature described, with the authority to make independent choices, free from immediate supervision, in significant matters that affect the business, or to carry out tasks that are directly and closely related to such work, no less than 50% of the time. If a position performs such work less than 50% of the time, and/or performs routine duties that are also performed by subordinates more than 40% of the time, it should be classified as: Field Supervisor.

Essential Functions

The functions listed describe the business purpose of this job. Specific duties or tasks may vary and be documented separately. The employee might not be required to perform all functions listed. Additional duties may be assigned, and functions may be modified, according to business necessity.
All assigned duties or tasks are deemed to be part of the essential functions, unless such duties or tasks are unrelated to the functions listed, in which case they are deemed to be other (non-essential) functions.
Employees are held accountable for successful job performance. Job performance standards may be documented separately, and may include functions, objectives, duties or tasks not specifically listed herein.
In performing functions, duties or tasks, employees are required to know and follow safe work practices, and to be aware of company policies and procedures related to job safety, including safety rules and regulations. Employees are required to notify superiors upon becoming aware of unsafe working conditions.
All functions, duties or tasks are to be carried out in an honest, ethical and professional manner, and to be performed in conformance with applicable company policies and procedures. In the event of uncertainty or lack of knowledge of company policies and procedures, employees are required to request clarification or explanations from superiors or authorized company representatives.
Manages a shift and/or segment of guarding operations at multiple sites, including supervision of subordinate officers and supervisory staff; ensures that personnel deliver high quality service.
Ensures that service expectations are being met through regular contact with clients; evaluates service quality, inspects posts and initiates corrective action in a timely manner as necessary.
Meets with line management and/or client representatives for status updates and to address any actual or potential problems; provides support during client start-ups; provides input to security planning, assessments and surveys; reviews post orders and communicates requirements and changes to affected personnel.
Participates in and coordinates with line management regarding the orientation, training, development and retention of high caliber staff; ensures that each staff member is treated with dignity and respect; coaches employees and carries out disciplinary actions, as necessary.
Maintains and submits payroll records and other employee and business information; reviews client and company reports for accuracy and timeliness.
Maintains a positive, professional environment in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies and procedures; acts to ensure that staff members understand and comply with applicable laws, regulations, policies and procedures.
Communicates and coordinates with line management regarding scheduling, staffing, equipment, record keeping, and related matters, to ensure smooth delivery of services; makes scheduling and staffing adjustments as needed to meet client requirements while controlling labor costs; reviews reports to ensure that commitments have been met and client directions have been followed.

Performs tasks and duties of a similar nature and scope as required for assigned office.

Additional qualifications may be specified and receive preference, depending upon the nature of the position.

Must be at least 18 years of age.
Must have a reliable means of communication (i.e., pager or phone).
Must have a reliable means of transportation (public or private).
Must have the legal right to work in the United States.
Must have the ability to speak, read, and write English.
Must have a High School Diploma or GED.
Must be willing to participate in the Company’s pre-employment screening process, including drug screen and background investigation.

Education/Experience: Associate’s Degree and 1 year of experience in security operations, or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job, as determined by the company. Additional relevant experience can be substituted for the required education on the basis of one calendar year of experience for one academic year of education.

Competencies (as Demonstrated Through Experience, Training, And/or Testing)

Understanding of security operations.
Knowledge of supervisory practices.
Planning, organizing and leadership skills.
Oral and written communications skills.
Strong customer service and service delivery orientation.
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively at various social levels and across diverse cultures.
Ability to take initiative and achieve results.

WORKING CONDITIONS (Physical/Mental Demands)

With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to perform effectively all essential functions. In addition to other demands, the demands of the job include:

Maintaining composure in dealing with authorities, clients, staff and the public, occasionally under conditions of urgency and in pressure situations.
Must undergo and meet company standards for background and reference checks, controlled substance testing, and behavioral selection survey.
Required ability to handle multiple tasks concurrently.
Handling and being exposed to sensitive and confidential information.
Regular use of vehicle required in the performance of duties.
Regular talking and hearing.
Occasional walking, reaching with hands and arms, stooping, kneeling, crouching and crawling.

About Southern Ports

Southern Ports operates the gateway ports of Albany, Bunbury, and Esperance, connecting regional WA to global markets. We focus on safe, efficient, and sustainable port operations, delivering value to our customers and communities. With a strong commitment to our people, we’re building a diverse, high-performing workforce to support the future of regional trade.

Benefits of Joining Southern Ports

Joining Southern Ports Authority comes with numerous benefits that cater to a wide range of professional and personal needs, some examples being:
Flexible Working Arrangements : Enjoy a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle and personal commitments.
Annual Health and Well-being Benefits : Take advantage of programs and resources aimed at maintaining your physical and mental health.
Salary Sacrificing Options : Maximise your take-home pay through tailored salary packaging arrangements such as Novated Car Leasing and Superannuation
Opportunity to Travel : Experience different geographical regions in Western Australia, enhancing your professional and personal growth.
Generous Purchase Leave Options : Gain additional leave options to suit your personal needs and preferences.

Salary:

$148,897 per annum – Increasing to $156,342 on January 1st 2027 + 12% Superannuation + regional allowance if based regionally.
The Role

Southern Ports is recruiting a Fixed Term Full Time Cyber Security Analyst (Cloud & IAM) until 30th June 2028 to join their team based at our Perth office. Reporting to the Cyber Security Lead the Cyber Security Analyst will be responsible for the governance, risk management, assurance and continuous improvement of Southern Ports' Cloud Security and Identity and Access Management (IAM) capabilities. The role serves as a recognised subject matter expert, providing expert security leadership, influencing technology decisions and ensuring security controls effectively manage organisational risk. The position is responsible for driving cyber security maturity to strengthen Southern Ports' cyber security posture, resilience and compliance obligations. All business activities of this role are in line with Southern Ports' mission, vision and corporate values.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Act as Southern Ports' lead subject matter expert for Cloud Security governance, standards and assurance activities.

Lead the continuous improvement of identity and access management controls including authentication, authorisation, access governance and privileged access management controls.
Lead the design and review of complex cloud security and identity solutions, evaluating major design options, business impacts, risks and trade-offs that align with security standards, risk appetite and compliance obligations.

Develop and deliver cyber security awareness initiatives that promote the secure use of cloud technologies and effective management of user identities and access.

Essential

Relevant tertiary qualifications in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security or a related discipline.
Microsoft Certified Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)

Demonstrated experience developing, implementing and maintaining cloud security and identity governance frameworks, standards, controls and assurance activities across Microsoft cloud environments, including Azure, Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365.
Demonstrated experience leading and delivering cloud security and IAM initiatives, including the implementation of security controls, risk assessments, business case development, project delivery, security uplift programs and contemporary security capabilities such as MFA, PAM, PIM and Zero Trust.
Demonstrated ability to provide strategic cyber security advice, influence decision-making and engage effectively with senior stakeholders on cloud security, identity governance, risk, compliance and cyber resilience matters.
Ability to travel to Southern Ports locations (Albany, Bunbury, Esperance, and Perth)

Desirable

Microsoft Certified Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)
Microsoft Certified Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100)
ISC2 CCSP
ISACA Cloud+
Demonstrated experience designing, implementing and optimising Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Privileged Access Management (PAM) capabilities within a complex enterprise environment.
Demonstrated experience leading and delivering secure-by-design initiatives, including the application of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Software Composition Analysis (SCA) and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) practices within cloud and technology delivery programs.
Experience developing, implementing and assessing cyber security controls within regulated, government or critical infrastructure environments, including the application of frameworks such as the Essential Eight, Australian Government ISM, SOCI Act and WA Government Cyber Security Policy.
Demonstrated experience developing executive reports, governance papers, business cases and risk assessments, with the ability to communicate complex cyber security concepts and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong stakeholder engagement, influencing and relationship management skills, with experience working across business, technology, vendor and government stakeholder groups.

As a Business Operations Manager you will serve as the financial and operational right hand to an Area Vice President and the Regional Sales Managers (RSMs) who report to them. ,

Location: Austin, Texas ( Onsite)

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and technically proficient Senior Project Manager with extensive experience in Genesys Engage and Genesys Cloud migration
to lead the end-to-end migration of an existing Genesys Engage contact center environment to a customized Genesys Cloud solution.
The ideal candidate will combine strong technical knowledge of contact center platforms with proven project and program management expertise. This individual will be responsible for assessing the current Genesys Engage environment, defining the migration strategy, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing technical dependencies, and ensuring a seamless transition to the target platform.
The successful candidate will possess excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. They should be comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities may evolve and requirements may be ambiguous.
We are looking for a proactive and strategic project leader who can work effectively at both the technical and program levels, influence architectural decisions, drive collaboration across teams, and ensure successful project delivery while maintaining alignment with business objectives.
Key Responsibilities

1. Project and Program Management

Lead all phases of the Genesys Engage to Genesys Cloud migration, from project initiation and planning through implementation, launch, and closure.
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, timelines, and success criteria.
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, resource forecasts, budgets, schedules, and dependency trackers.
Manage project risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, scope changes, and mitigation strategies.
Coordinate cross-functional teams and ensure accountability for project deliverables.
Drive project execution in alignment with organizational standards, business priorities, and strategic objectives.
Facilitate project governance meetings, stakeholder reviews, status updates, and executive reporting.
Lead project retrospectives, lessons-learned sessions, and formal project closeout activities.

2. Genesys Engage Environment Assessment

Conduct a comprehensive assessment of the existing Genesys Engage environment, including architecture, platform components, integrations, configurations, and dependencies.
Evaluate the current contact center infrastructure, call flows, routing strategies, IVR functionality, reporting, and other relevant capabilities.
Identify technical gaps, operational challenges, migration constraints, and opportunities for improvement.
Document the existing environment and establish a clear baseline for migration planning.
Collaborate with technical teams to understand legacy system dependencies and determine migration requirements.

3. Genesys Cloud Migration Planning and Execution

Develop a detailed migration roadmap covering project phases, timelines, resources, dependencies, risks, and mitigation plans.
Partner with solution architects and engineering teams to define the target Genesys Cloud architecture and migration approach.
Coordinate configuration migration, integration updates, data migration activities, and environment setup.
Ensure the target solution meets requirements for scalability, reliability, security, performance, and business continuity.
Manage migration readiness, cutover planning, implementation sequencing, rollback planning, and production launch activities.
Track progress against project milestones and proactively resolve issues that could affect delivery.
Ensure minimal business disruption during migration and transition to the new contact center platform.

4. Technical Requirements and Solution Architecture

Lead the development and documentation of business requirements, functional specifications, and technical requirements.
Facilitate current-state and future-state process mapping, business analysis, and process optimization.
Work closely with architects, developers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to evaluate solution options.
Support architectural discussions involving Genesys Engage, Genesys Cloud, APIs, integrations, networking, and contact center technologies.
Identify integration points with enterprise applications, CRM systems, databases, reporting platforms, and third-party solutions.
Validate technical designs against business requirements, enterprise architecture standards, and operational needs.
Ensure technical decisions, assumptions, configurations, and design changes are properly documented.

Identify gaps, risks, and unstated assumptions in proposals early, and surface these to the Head of PMO before they escalate into delivery problems

Maintain a library of process documentation that reflects how DAVI actually operates, not just how it was designed to operate on paper

jobs.title: Senior Cyber Threat Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

ACTIVE SECURITY CLEARANCE AT THE TS/SCI POLYGRAPH LEVEL IS REQUIRED

The Signals Analyst
serves as a specialized technical authority, delivering dedicated signals analysis support. In this role, you will perform technical signal collection, evaluation, and processing with a primary focus on Industrial Control Systems (ICS)
and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA)
network environments and operational technology (OT) protocols. By evaluating complex signal environments and identifying non-standard communication pathways, the Signals Analyst translates technical signal discoveries into actionable intelligence and operational target development in direct support of national cyber objectives.

The annual base salary range for this role is $184,000-$218,000 (USD) , which does not include discretionary bonus compensation or our comprehensive benefits package. Actual compensation offered to the successful candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level, among other things.

,

Required Skills

Signals Evaluation & Processing:Perform technical signal analysis, parameter definition, and signal processing to extract intelligence, identify traffic patterns, and map operational communication links.
ICS/SCADA Domain Analysis: Conduct deep-dive signals analysis on specialized data streams, telemetry, and communication protocols associated with Industrial Control Systems (ICS), SCADA networks, and physical infrastructure automation.
Operational Support for USCC: Collaborate directly with U.S. Cyber Command planners and mission teams to integrate signal insights into cyber operational workflows and target development pipelines.
Reporting & Technical Intelligence: Produce comprehensive technical intelligence reports, signal characterization profiles, and analytical summaries for mission partners and joint cyber components.
Tool & Method Optimization: Refine analytical methodologies and leverage specialized signals analysis tools to evaluate emerging, non-standard, or complex signal environments.

Education: Bachelor’s Degree
in Data Science, Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline, PLUS 8+ years
of professional experience in data science, NLP, or software engineering OR High School Diploma / GED
, PLUS 12+ years
of specialized technical experience in lieu of a degree.

,

Desired Skills

Familiarity with specialized OT/ICS communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870-5, BACnet, PROFINET).

Experience utilizing advanced customer signals processing platforms and data analysis frameworks.

Knowledge of joint cyber operational planning, offensive/defensive cyber workflows, and threat matrix integration.

,

Nyla Technology Solutions delivers exceptional Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Science, and Software Engineering services for the U.S. Government. Nyla embraces a forward-thinking and bold approach at every turn, earning us a solid reputation of technical trendsetters within the industry. We have a passion for developing solutions that have a quick and immediate impact on mission. Headquartered in Columbia, Maryland, our customers love how we tackle their most challenging problems and get things done.

If you have the unique experience and expertise we are seeking, along with the desire and determination to invest your time and energy as a part of Nyla’s team,

Taking Care of All of You

Nyla provides a top-of-market compensation and benefits package. And through our unique Nyla FLEX program, we custom tailor these benefits to best fit your lifestyle.

The Nyla FLEX benefit program is designed to offer you flexibility in the 3 biggest areas of your life: your pay, your leave, and your schedule.

PAY - Nyla starts with 4 weeks of Annual Leave plus 11 holidays and an additional day of Annual Leave for each year you’re at the company. You have the flexibility to cash out your annual leave hours, opt out of other Nyla benefits, and/or arrange for additional hours on contract* (over 40 hrs/week). Our Professional Development offers $5,000 per year to be used towards fees, tuition, or time off for your continued growth. We even have a student loan repayment program and we provide 8 hours of volunteering annually so you can support your community, making your world a better place.

jobs.description:
Assent Advisory Group

Full Time

Patuxent River, Md

Posted 12 hours ago

Locations:

Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Md

Job Description

Assent Advisory Group is seeking an experienced Financial Analyst or Data Analyst to support U.S. Navy Ordnance Valuation, Financial Audit Readiness, and Audit Remediation initiatives at Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland.

This position will support Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) and Portfolio Acquisition Execution (PAE) Munitions in executing ordnance valuation, reconciliation, data validation, and financial audit support activities.

The successful candidate will analyze financial and inventory data, reconcile Government acceptance documentation against authoritative financial and ordnance systems, identify valuation discrepancies, and assist with audit response activities.

The role supports the Navy’s implementation of Statement of Federal Financial Accounting Standards (SFFAS) 3 and SFFAS 48 for ordnance inventory, Operating Materials and Supplies (OM&S), and opening balances.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, experience performing complex reconciliations, and familiarity with federal financial management, accounting standards, audit remediation, and Navy financial systems.

This position requires on-site support approximately 2–3 days per week at Naval Air Station Patuxent River. The candidate must possess an active Secret clearance and be able to work in a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) as required.

Role And Responsibilities

Provide financial and data analysis support for Navy ordnance valuation and audit readiness initiatives.
Support the implementation of SFFAS 3 and SFFAS 48 requirements related to inventory and OM&S.
Track assets accepted by the Government, including DD Form 250 acceptance documentation, that have not yet been recorded in the Ordnance Information System.
Reconcile Government acceptance records against OIS and Navy ERP.
Perform independent research to identify discrepancies among financial, procurement, and inventory records.
Review Wide Area Workflow (WAWF) acceptance records, Navy ERP procurement transactions, contractor documentation, and OIS transaction logs.
Validate data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across authoritative systems.
Research unmatched transactions, missing records, and valuation discrepancies.
Conduct complex financial and inventory reconciliations.
Support NAVAIR and PAE Munitions with Government data calls, formal taskers, and reconciliation exception tracking.
Coordinate with multiple stakeholders to obtain documentation, validate responses, and resolve outstanding issues.
Support IPA Provided by Client (PBC) audit requests.
Utilize the Audit Response Center (ARC) to track audit inquiries, responses, and supporting evidence.
Prepare and organize audit-ready documentation packages.
Assist with audit responses related to E&C roll-forward and valuation testing.
Research audit exceptions and support corrective action and remediation efforts.
Prepare analytical summaries, reconciliations, trackers, reports, and briefing materials.
Maintain accurate records and support recurring and ad hoc reporting requirements.

Experience

Experience performing financial analysis, complex reconciliations, data validation, or accounting analysis.
Experience supporting financial audit response, audit readiness, audit remediation, or internal controls.
Experience researching discrepancies across financial, procurement, inventory, or operational systems.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work with complex financial datasets.
Experience coordinating data calls, reviewing responses, and managing stakeholder follow-up.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with strict deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience supporting federal government, Department of Defense, or Navy financial management programs preferred.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Economics, or a related field preferred.
Relevant professional experience may be considered in accordance with applicable labor category requirements.

Qualifications

U.S. Citizen.
Ability to obtain and maintain CAC access.
Ability to work on-site at NAS Patuxent River approximately 2–3 days weekly.
Ability to work in a SCIF when required.
Ability to travel up to approximately 25–30%, as needed.
Strong discretion when handling sensitive financial, procurement, and audit information.

The following professional certifications are preferred:

Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
Certified Government Financial Manager (CGFM)
Certified Defense Financial Manager (CDFM)
Data analytics or business intelligence certifications

Preferred Experience

Navy ordnance valuation or inventory accounting.
Operating Materials and Supplies (OM&S).
SFFAS 3 and SFFAS 48.
Financial Improvement and Audit Readiness.
Navy ERP.
Ordnance Information System (OIS).
Wide Area Workflow (WAWF).
DD Form 250 acceptance documentation.
Audit Response Center (ARC).
E&C testing, inventory reconciliation, and audit remediation.

Job Features

Job Category Data Scientist, Financial Consultant

số 35 Nguyễn Huệ, P. Sài Gòn, TP. Hồ Chí Minh.

Thỏa thuận.

Xây dựng và quản lý các tài liệu nghiệp vụ như SRS, Data Entities (mô tả đối tượng), Workflow, Wireframe và các tài liệu liên quan.
Làm việc chặt chẽ với PM, Developer, QC và các bên liên quan để đảm bảo yêu cầu được hiểu đúng và triển khai chính xác.
Hỗ trợ team trong quá trình thiết kế, phát triển và triển khai sản phẩm; giải đáp các vấn đề liên quan đến yêu cầu nghiệp vụ.
Theo dõi tiến độ thực hiện yêu cầu, đánh giá tác động của các thay đổi và cập nhật tài liệu nghiệp vụ trong suốt vòng đời sản phẩm.
Hỗ trợ người dùng nội bộ, khách hàng hoặc đối tác trong quá trình vận hành, xử lý các vấn đề liên quan đến nghiệp vụ của hệ thống.
Phân tích quy trình nghiệp vụ hiện tại, đề xuất giải pháp cải tiến nhằm tối ưu vận hành và nâng cao trải nghiệm người dùng.
Biết ứng dụng AI vào quá trình làm việc.

Tốt nghiệp Đại học/Cao đẳng chuyên ngành Công nghệ Thông tin, Hệ thống Thông tin, Kinh tế, Tài chính hoặc các ngành liên quan.
Có từ fresher tới 5 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí Business Analyst hoặc các vị trí tương đương.
Hiểu biết về quy trình phát triển phần mềm (SDLC), Agile/Waterfall; có kinh nghiệm phân tích yêu cầu và xây dựng tài liệu nghiệp vụ (BRD, SRS, User Story, Use Case, Wireframe…).
Có kiến thức cơ bản về cơ sở dữ liệu, API và luồng tích hợp hệ thống; thành thạo các công cụ như Jira, Figma, Draw.io, Visio hoặc các công cụ tương đương.
Khả năng giao tiếp tốt bằng tiếng Anh, đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật; có các chứng chỉ tiếng anh TOEIC, IELTS,… là một lợi thế.
Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm trong Fintech, Thanh toán điện tử, Ngân hàng số, Ví điện tử hoặc E-commerce.
Có kỹ năng giao tiếp, phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề tốt; chủ động, trách nhiệm, có khả năng làm việc nhóm và quản lý công việc hiệu quả.

Làm việc trong môi trường fintech năng động, cập nhật nhiều công nghệ mới.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst - Clearance Required
jobs.description:
Overview

Seeking an Operations Analyst
for a US Army client to support military (highest ranking: O-6 / Colonel), civilian (highest ranking: GS-15) and contractor support teams supporting development of modernized defense business systems . The Operations Analyst is responsible for enabling efficient daily operations for the Pro ject Manager (PM) and senior leadership through scheduling, tasker management, correspondence oversight, knowledge management, and general operational support. The successful candidate must be able to work in a fast-paced environment that requires strong organizational and interpersonal skills, able to multi-task and complete duties within required timeframe and demonstrate professionalism, attention to detail, and confidentiality at all times .

Work location is at the client site at Fort Belvoir, Virginia 4-5 days a week.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

Manage daily O ‑ 6 office operations, including customer service, senior ‑ leader schedule management (PM, DPM, and O ‑ 6 staff), travel authorizations and vouchers utilizing DTS, meeting logistics , and timely dissemination of schedule changes. Ensure meetings have appropriate coverage , agendas, and supporting materials, proactively adjusting schedules based on program priorities.
Interface with all levels of private industry and vendors. Route/direct inquiries and requests to appropriate point of contact and/or resource. Schedule meetings with the appropriate personnel , escort meeting participant(s) to meeting location(s). 
Review all incoming and outgoing correspondence including memorandums (in accordance with Army Regulation 25-50), presentations, briefings, reports, read-ahead materials, and manuals; check for formatting, proofread, and make edits as necessary, prepare documents for signature, and ensure proper routing through the program staff and higher headquarters staff where applicable. 
Monitor and manage taskers in the Army tasker automated system to ensure the program submits taskers on time or requests needed extensions.  Selects appropriate respondents for taskers, provides background instructions and files, and submits tasker responses when complete.   
Ma nage PM LOG-FIN SharePoint site content and support process automation using Army Artificial Intelligence tools and other available tools such as Microsoft PowerApps. Monitor knowledge management and records management processes and activities to ensure O6 and O5 Product Management Office information is maintained and is accessible to stakeholders. 
Maintain the program conference rooms and manage the conference room calendars. Provide necessary assistance to conference room users, facilitate senior-level meetings; to include the use of video teleconferencing.  
Provide event coordination and Protocol Support for all official functions (Charter Ceremonies, Promotions, and Retirements) or organizational activities.
Support the O-6 Operations team with projects and analysis as needed.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or commensurate years of experience.
At least 5-10 years of experience working for/within Army and/or DoD organizations, either as military personnel, government civilian, or as a contractor supporting the Army. 
3-5 years of experience providing direct support for multiple senior level program directors and/or managers (O-6, GS-15, VP, or higher). 
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written, excellent organizational skills. 
Ability to establish and maintain working relationships with internal and external customers, and the ability to work independently and take a proactive role. 
Must be proficient with MS Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project, Word, and Access), SharePoint, Teams, as well as office equipment such as scanners, copiers, and fax machines. 
Possess and demonstrate the ability to work effectively with little direct supervision, independently, and with senior and mid-level staff to prioritize according to the senior staff requirements.  

Desired Qualifications

Active Secret Clearance.
Experience composing/reviewing formal documents/correspondence in accordance with applicable policies and guidelines such as Army Regulation 25-50. 
Demonstrated working knowledge of the Defense Travel System.
Agile certifications .
Program Management certifications. 

Target salary range: $115,000-$135,000

For over 240 years combined, Berry Street and Yooralla have been at the forefront of supporting Australians with a disability and those experiencing poverty, violence and abuse. Now, as one unified organisation, we bring together unparalleled expertise and a shared commitment to empowering individuals and families to thrive, while upholding and championing their human rights. We believe in a future where everyone has the opportunity to live the fulfilling life they choose for themselves, free from the impacts of trauma, violence, and abuse, achieved safely and with dignity

The Opportunity

Melbourne Office, Wurundjeri Country
Hybrid WFH 2 days/ 3 days in our CBD office
Full Time, Fixed term role until 30 November 2027 (parental leave cover).
$101K annual salary plus super and salary packaging (pro rata)

We are seeking a Client Data Analyst to join our Information Management & Analytics team and play a key role in supporting data-driven decision making across the organisation.

This is an exciting opportunity for a data professional who enjoys working with stakeholders, building reporting solutions, improving data quality, and contributing to strategic initiatives that enhance service delivery.

Reporting to the Manager, Analytics & Reporting, you will support the delivery of analytics, reporting, and data quality initiatives across the organisation's client-facing services. You will work closely with operational leaders, program teams, and corporate functions to ensure client data is accurate, accessible, and transformed into actionable insights.

Analytics & Reporting

You will be responsible for developing and maintaining dashboards, supporting reporting requirements, analysing business challenges, and identifying opportunities to improve data maturity and reporting capability across the organisation.
Support the delivery of client data analysis and reporting strategies under the guidance of the Information Management & Analytics leadership team.
Document, maintain and improve reporting metrics, definitions and data sources.
Configure, implement and administer reporting and analytics solutions across client information systems.

Strategy & Continuous Improvement

Contribute to the implementation and ongoing development of the Client Data Strategy.
Support strategic projects with reporting and analytics requirements and facilitate transition into operational business processes.

About You

You're someone who combines strong technical data skills with a genuine interest in helping people make better decisions. We are looking for an individual who is confident working with data, systems and stakeholders alike, you're motivated by uncovering insights, improving data quality, and contributing to services that make a real difference in the community.

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Bring

Experience developing and maintaining dashboards, reports and data visualisations using Power BI, SQL, Excel or similar tools.
Strong knowledge of data management principles, including data validation, governance and quality assurance practices.
Experience working with complex datasets across multiple systems and data sources.
The ability to document reporting requirements, business rules, metrics and data definitions in a clear and structured manner.
Experience configuring and administering reporting and analytics solutions to meet operational and organisational needs.
An understanding of how data structures, system integrations and reporting environments support reliable business intelligence.
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver quality outcomes within agreed timeframes.
A collaborative and proactive approach, with a commitment to continuous improvement and learning.

Our Benefits

We offer a supportive, purpose-driven environment where you can make a meaningful impact:

Salary packaging benefits, including meals and accommodation
Flexible work arrangements
Generous leave conditions + 17.5% leave loading to optimse your annual leave!
Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your immediate family
The opportunity to contribute to an organisation supporting children, young people and people with disability across Victoria

How To Express Your Interest

Simply submit your cover letter addressing your interest in the role and CV.
This role will close 11pm, Sunday 8 November 2026.
Queries to Doug Harding, Head of Information Management & Analytics, 9421 9328.

jobs.description:
About Nexon

Nexon America is a branch of Nexon Co., Ltd., a global video game publisher and leading developer of online virtual worlds for PCs, consoles, and mobile devices. Nexon proudly offers celebrated franchises like MapleStory and Mabinogi that have been enjoyed by millions of players for over two decades. When we founded our Nexon America branch in 2006, we made it our goal to bring those unique games to western players using a player-first approach. We achieve that goal by applying our team’s outstanding free-to-play expertise and live game support to every decision, every day.

But we’re committed to more than our games! Here at Nexon America, we’re all about open communication, diversity, mutual respect, and collaboration, so we can bring out the best in each other. Nexies find support, friendship, and career growth all in one place! And because we know a healthy work-life balance is the key to happiness, Nexies also enjoy flexible hours, a hybrid work model, and extra perks like food trucks, happy hours, and team events. It’s why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work certification for 6 years running!

We’re looking to expand our team with passionate individuals who want to learn, play, and grow with us. Ready for a new challenge?

Summary Of Position

Nexon America is looking for a Data Analyst to provide in-depth data mining and analyses to multiple departments, with a focus on understanding our players and identifying ways to improve the user experience within our games. In this role, you will empower our teams with actionable data derived from your own data exploration, experiments, and analyses.

We are currently working in the office 2-3x a week in a hybrid work model.

Job Responsibilities

Design and develop data analyses to create unique business insights; perform detailed data exploration and validation to understand players’ behavior and trends.
Identify key analytic metrics; build interactive data visualizations and present key insights to inform business decisions and drive growth; examine and analyze available information to determine patterns and gaps at a strategic level and recommend a course of action to support internal and external users.
Research and analyze web and game usage data and recommend solutions; analyze the user experience and business processes to identify opportunities for improvement.
Work cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to translate business data needs into analysis specifications and validate requirements against strategic goals and project objectives.
Develop innovative projects and hone cutting-edge skills in Data Cloud technologies, Data Science models, Data storytelling, and AI.
Other duties as assigned

Work Experience

3+ years of experience in data analytics, sales analysis, consulting, statistics, or a related field
Experience with data extraction and manipulation tools and Data Mining tools
Experience creating data visualization
Online gaming experience preferred

Education, Professional Training, Technical Training or Certification

Master's Degree preferred or Bachelor's degree with equivalent experience

Knowledge/Skills

Excellent knowledge of statistical analysis
Ability to extract data by writing your own SQL queries
Experience using Tableau or similar BI tools
Experience using Google Analytics preferred
Programming for data analysis (R or Python) preferred
Ability to translate complex data into stories for diverse stakeholders
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
Able to manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment
Exceptional Excel and PowerPoint skills
Excellent time and project management skills

Management has the right to add or change duties and job requirements at any time.

Nexon’s Benefits And Perks

We offer medical, dental and vision plans for you, your spouse or domestic partner and your children. Employees who enroll in the high deductible health plan receive an annual employer contribution to a health savings account and company paid hospital indemnity benefits. We also provide company paid life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability benefits as well as access to voluntary life and AD&D for yourself and your dependents, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) savings plan with a company match, and pet insurance. Nexies are encouraged to take advantage of our monthly wellness credit, participate in lunchtime yoga, and enroll in language classes. We host bi-monthly catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and maintain a well-stocked snack bar. To help you maintain a good work life balance, we offer paid time off, sick days, company holidays, and a year-end break.

Nexon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Compensation Description For Pay Transparency (annually)

The base salary range for this position in El Segundo, CA is $100,000 - $125,000 annually.

Our salary ranges are determined by market data based on position and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum salaries for that position. An individual’s pay is determined by factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s qualifications, skills, experiences, relevant education or training, and location.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work. This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, however the salary range listed in this job posting reflects the base salary only.

We have been made aware of fraudulent recruitment activities by individuals falsely claiming to represent Nexon America. Our recruiters will only contact you from official company email addresses ending in @nexon.com and will follow a formal interview process. We will never
request for payment or personal financial information such as photos of government-issued identification during the recruitment process or offer a job without a formal interview process. If you receive suspicious email, we advise you to mark the email as junk or spam, so your email provider will block future messages from the sender.
